objective: Establish from Claude Code's current official documentation how to set the reasoning effort of the main thread and how to lower the autocompact threshold, so HolyAgent can ship a high-effort root with a small context.
scope: Official sources: code.claude.com docs (settings, subagents, model configuration, environment variables, plugins), the Claude Code changelog. Look the facts up even if they seem known; they change often.
constraints: Read-only. Report under 700 words, every fact with its URL; separate sourced facts from inference. Keep working until everything asked is done, then stop and report.

criteria.text: Agent effort: whether an agent file's frontmatter effort field applies when that agent runs as the main thread (the agent setting or --agent), and its allowed values
Session effort: the settings.json key and the environment variable, if any, that set the default effort of a session, with allowed values, and their precedence

Autocompact: every supported way to lower the autocompact threshold (setting or environment variable such as CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE), its unit, whether it works with 1M-token windows, and its limits
Scope: which of these a plugin can ship (plugin settings.json, agent frontmatter) versus user or project settings only
